```{r Read csv for behav models, warning=FALSE}
cor_study2 <- read_csv("../results/stats/behavior_cor_spillover_skip_regress_bayesian_scaled.csv")
spec(cor_study2)
```

```{r Orders & labels}
# --- Orders & labels --------------------------------------------------------
effect_order   <- c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal")
measure_order  <- c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect")
mode_order     <- c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")
contrast_order <- c("c1", "c2")
```


```{r Create correlation table cor_behav}

# --- Flags & formatters -----------------------------------------------------
cor_study2 <- cor_study2 %>%
  mutate(bold = (rho_lower > 0 & rho_upper > 0) | (rho_lower < 0 & rho_upper < 0))

fmt_mean <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
fmt_ci   <- function(lo, hi) sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lo, hi)

contrast_label <- function(mode, contrast) {
  switch(mode,
    "InDiCo"  = if (contrast == "c1") "session 1" else "session 2",
    "PoTeC"   = if (contrast == "c1") "In"        else "Out",
    "OneStop" = if (contrast == "c1") "repeated"  else "normal",
    "GECO-NL" = if (contrast == "c1") "L1"        else "L2",
    "GECO-ZH" = if (contrast == "c1") "L1"        else "L2",
    "HKC"     = if (contrast == "c1") "Paragraph" else "Sentence",
    contrast
  )
}

# return mean or CI; bold both if both CI bounds share sign
get_cell <- function(mode, contrast, effect, measure, part = c("mean","ci")) {
  part <- match.arg(part)
  row <- cor_study2 %>%
    filter(mode == !!mode, Contrast == !!contrast,
           effect == !!effect, measures == !!measure)
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return("--")
  mean_txt <- fmt_mean(row$rho_mean)
  ci_txt   <- fmt_ci(row$rho_lower, row$rho_upper)
  if (row$bold) {
    mean_txt <- paste0("\\textbf{", mean_txt, "}")
    ci_txt   <- paste0("\\textbf{", ci_txt, "}")
  }
  if (part == "mean") mean_txt else ci_txt
}

# --- Build LaTeX lines ------------------------------------------------------
row_strut <- "\\rule{0pt}{2.2ex}"  # extra height

lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2.2pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.22}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  "\\begin{tabular}{@{}>{\\centering\\arraybackslash}m{0.9cm}@{}c ccccccccc@{}}",
  "\\toprule",
  # "% \\midrule",
  # Header row 1
  "\\multicolumn{2}{>{\\centering\\arraybackslash}m{2.6cm}}{\\large\\textbf{Correlation b/w}} & ",
  "\\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Word Length Spillover}} & ",
  "\\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Lexical Frequency Spillover}} & ",
  "\\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Surprisal Spillover}} \\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){3-5}\\cmidrule(lr){6-8}\\cmidrule(lr){9-11}",
  # Header row 2
  "\\multicolumn{2}{c}{} & ",
  paste0("\\textbf{Skip Rate} & \\textbf{Regr. Rate} & \\textbf{Local Eff.} & ",
         "\\textbf{Skip Rate} & \\textbf{Regr. Rate} & \\textbf{Local Eff.} & ",
         "\\textbf{Skip Rate} & \\textbf{Regr. Rate} & \\textbf{Local Eff.}"),
  " \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  "\\rowcolors{3}{gray!08}{white}"
)

# Data rows
for (mode in mode_order) {
  for (j in seq_along(contrast_order)) {
    # print(j)
    contrast <- contrast_order[j]
    label <- contrast_label(mode, contrast)

    # row 1 (means)
    row1 <- c()
    if (j == 1) {
      row1 <- c(row1, paste0("\\multirow{4}{*}{\\centering\\rotatebox[origin=c]{90}{\\textbf{", mode, "}}}"))
    } else {
      row1 <- c(row1, "")
    }
    row1 <- c(row1, paste0("\\multirow{2}{*}{\\textbf{", label, "}}"))
    first <- TRUE
    for (eff in effect_order) {
      for (meas in measure_order) {
        v <- get_cell(mode, contrast, eff, meas, "mean")
        if (first) { v <- paste0(row_strut, " ", v); first <- FALSE }
        row1 <- c(row1, v)
      }
    }
    lines <- c(lines, paste(row1, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")

    # row 2 (CI)
    row2 <- c("", "")
    first2 <- TRUE
    for (eff in effect_order) {
      for (meas in measure_order) {
        v2 <- get_cell(mode, contrast, eff, meas, "ci")
        if (first2) { v2 <- paste0(row_strut, " ", v2); first2 <- FALSE }
        row2 <- c(row2, v2)
      }
    }
    lines <- c(lines, paste(row2, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
    if (j < length(contrast_order)) {
      print("add space")
  lines <- c(lines, "\\addlinespace[6pt]")
}
  }
  lines <- c(lines, "% \\midrule")
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end normalsize",
  "\\caption{Top row per contrast shows $\\rho$; the row beneath shows $[\\text{lower},\\,\\text{upper}]$.}",
  "\\label{cor_behav_meas}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# --- Write LaTeX to file ----------------------------------------------------
writeLines(lines, "../results/latex/cor_behav_meas2.tex")

```

```{r Read csv for pop effect, warning=FALSE}
pred_order  <- c("Word Len.","Lex. Freq.","Surprisal")
loc_order   <- c("Local","Spillover")

fmt <- function(m, lo, up) {
  same_sign <- (lo > 0 & up > 0) | (lo < 0 & up < 0)
  ifelse(
    same_sign,
    sprintf("\\sigestci{%.2f}{%.2f}{%.2f}", m, lo, up),
    sprintf("\\nonsigestci{%.2f}{%.2f}{%.2f}", m, lo, up)
  )
}

# Read and prepare (as in your pipeline, but keep 'mode' for rows)
fixtab<- read_csv("../results/stats/fixed_effect_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(predictor != "Contrast") %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = factor(predictor, levels = pred_order),
    location  = factor(location,  levels = loc_order),
    cell      = fmt(mean_eff, lower, upper)
  )
fixtab
```

```{r Create table for pop effect}
get_cell_fixed <- function(mode, pred, loc){ 
  sub <- fixtab %>% 
    filter(mode == !!mode, predictor == !!pred, location == !!loc) 
  sub$cell[1] }

# print(get_cell_fixed("PoTeC", "Lex. Freq.", "Local"))
# print(get_cell_fixed("InDiCo", "Word Len.", "Spillover"))

top_header_cells <- vapply(pred_order, function(p) {
  sprintf("\\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\textbf{%s}}", p)
}, character(1))
# print(top_header_cells)
sub_header_cells <- rep(loc_order, times = length(pred_order))
# print(sub_header_cells)

header_row1 <- paste(
  "\\multirow{2}{*}{\\shortstack[c]{\\textbf{Pop. Effect}\\\\\\textbf{(log-ms)}}} &",
  paste(top_header_cells, collapse = " & "),
  "\\\\"
)

# Row 2: (first cell omitted; occupied by the multirow)
header_row2 <- paste(
  "&",
  paste(sprintf("\\textbf{%s}", sub_header_cells), collapse = " & "),
  "\\\\"
)



# cmidrule ranges for each predictor group (start at column 2 because col 1 = Mode)
cmid_rules <- {
  starts <- 2 + 2 * (0:(length(pred_order)-1))
  ends   <- starts + 1
  paste0("\\cmidrule(lr){", starts, "-", ends, "}", collapse = "")
}

# --- Build LaTeX lines ---
row_strut <- "\\rule{0pt}{2.2ex}"

lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2.5pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.22}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  # 1 column for Mode + 6 data columns (3 predictors × 2 locations)
  "\\begin{tabular}{@{}lcccccc@{}}",
  "\\toprule",
  header_row1,
  cmid_rules,
  header_row2,
  "\\midrule"
)

# --- Data rows (modes) ---
col_keys <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pred_order, function(p) {
  data.frame(predictor = p, location = loc_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
# col_keys

for (mode in mode_order) {
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(col_keys)), function(i) {
    get_cell_fixed(mode, col_keys$predictor[i], col_keys$location[i])
  }, character(1))
  cells[1] <- paste0(row_strut, " ", cells[1])  # slight height
  lines <- c(lines, paste(c(mode, cells), collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end normalsize",
  "\\caption{Population level effect summaries by predictor (Local vs. Spillover). }",
  "\\label{tab:pop_effects}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# --- Write & print ---
out_path <- "../results/latex/pop_eff.tex"
dir.create(dirname(out_path), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(lines, out_path)
message("Wrote: ", out_path)

# cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r}
rb <- read_csv("../results/stats/spillover_measurement_reliability.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  # filter(location == "spillover") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cor_len, cor_freq, cor_surp),
    names_to = "predictor",
    values_to = "eff_size"
  ) %>%
  mutate(predictor = recode(predictor,
                            cor_len  = "Word Len.",
                            cor_freq = "Lex. Freq.",
                            cor_surp = "Surprisal")) %>%
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = c("local", "spillover"), labels = c("Local", "Spillover")),
    predictor = factor(predictor, levels = c("Word Len.", "Lex. Freq.", "Surprisal")),
         mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC"))
         ) %>%
  group_by(location, mode, predictor) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_eff = mean(eff_size),
    # lower    = quantile(eff_size, 0.025),
    # upper    = quantile(eff_size, 0.975),
    lower = hdi(eff_size, credMass = 0.95)[1],
    upper = hdi(eff_size, credMass = 0.95)[2],
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

View(rb)
```

```{r}
get_cell_fixed <- function(mod, pred, loc){
  sub <- rb_tab %>%
    dplyr::filter(mode == !!mod, predictor == !!pred, location == !!loc)
  if (nrow(sub) != 1) stop(sprintf("Missing/duplicate cell for (%s, %s, %s)", mod, pred, loc))
  sub$cell[1]
}

# --- Header pieces ----------------------------------------------------------
# header_row1 <- paste(

#   paste(top_header_cells, collapse = " & "),
#   "\\\\"
# )
header_row1 <- paste(
  "\\multirow{2}{*}{\\shortstack[c]{\\textbf{Reliability}\\\\({\\boldmath$\\hat{r}$})}} &",
  paste(top_header_cells, collapse = " & "),
  "\\\\"
)

# Second header row: NO first cell (it's occupied by the multirow above)
header_row2 <- paste(
  "&",
  paste(sprintf("\\textbf{%s}", sub_header_cells), collapse = " & "),
  "\\\\"
)

top_header_cells <- vapply(pred_order, function(p) {
  sprintf("\\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\textbf{%s}}", p)
}, character(1))

sub_header_cells <- rep(loc_order, times = length(pred_order))

cmid_rules <- {
  starts <- 2 + 2 * (0:(length(pred_order)-1))
  ends   <- starts + 1
  paste0("\\cmidrule(lr){", starts, "-", ends, "}", collapse = "")
}

# --- Build LaTeX ------------------------------------------------------------
row_strut <- "\\rule{0pt}{2.2ex}"

lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2.5pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.22}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  "\\begin{tabular}{@{}lcccccc@{}}",  # 1 col for Mode + 3*2 subcols
  "\\toprule",
  header_row1,
  cmid_rules,
  header_row2,
  "\\midrule"
)

# Interleaved column keys: for each predictor -> Local, Spillover
col_keys <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pred_order, function(p) {
  data.frame(predictor = p, location = loc_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
# print(col_keys)

# --- Data rows (modes) ------------------------------------------------------
for (mod in mode_order) {
  # print(mod)
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(col_keys)), function(i) {
    get_cell_fixed(mod, col_keys$predictor[i], col_keys$location[i])
  }, character(1))
  cells[1] <- paste0(row_strut, " ", cells[1])  # slight height on first data cell
  lines <- c(lines, paste(c(mod, cells), collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
}

# --- Close table ------------------------------------------------------------
lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end scriptsize",
  "\\caption{Overall reliability estimates.}",
  "\\label{tab:overall_rel}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# --- Write & print ----------------------------------------------------------
out_path <- "../results/latex/overall_reliability.tex"
dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(lines, out_path)
cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r Psychometric_profile table}
m <- read_rds("../models/psycho-profile/indico_profile_log_gaze_duration.rds")

# 1) grab fixed effects and keep only what's needed (rounded to 3 decimals)
f <- brms::fixef(m, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
f_df <- data.frame(
  term     = rownames(f),
  Estimate = round(f[, "Estimate"], 3),
  l95      = round(f[, "Q2.5"],     3),
  u95      = round(f[, "Q97.5"],    3),
  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# 2) formatting function (uses your macros)
fmt <- function(m, lo, up) {
  same_sign <- (lo > 0 & up > 0) | (lo < 0 & up < 0)
  ifelse(
    same_sign,
    sprintf("\\sigestci{%.3f}{%.3f}{%.3f}", m, lo, up),
    sprintf("\\nonsigestci{%.3f}{%.3f}{%.3f}", m, lo, up)
  )
}

# 3) helper to fetch an interaction regardless of order "a:b" vs "b:a"
get_cell_interaction <- function(a, b) {
  t1 <- paste0(a, ":", b)
  t2 <- paste0(b, ":", a)
  row <- f_df[f_df$term == t1 | f_df$term == t2, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1) stop("Missing/duplicate interaction term: ", a, ":", b)
  fmt(row$Estimate, row$l95, row$u95)
}

# 4) table layout (row and column labels)
row_labels <- c("Previous Word Len.", "Previous Lex. Freq.", "Previous Surprisal")
col_headers <- c("Interaction b/w", "Reading Fluency", "Working Memory",
                 "Intelligence", "Cognitive Control")

# interactions in the required order for each row
row_terms <- list(
  list(c("prev_len","reading"),      c("prev_len","memory"),
       c("prev_len","intelligence"), c("prev_len","cogcontr")),
  list(c("prev_freq","reading"),      c("prev_freq","memory"),
       c("prev_freq","intelligence"), c("prev_freq","cogcontr")),
  list(c("prev_surp","reading"),      c("prev_surp","memory"),
       c("prev_surp","intelligence"), c("prev_surp","cogcontr"))
)

# 5) build LaTeX lines (simple booktabs table)
lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{6pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  paste0("\\textbf{", paste(col_headers, collapse = "} & \\textbf{"), "} \\\\"),
  "\\midrule"
)

for (i in seq_along(row_labels)) {
  cells <- vapply(row_terms[[i]], function(pair) {
    get_cell_interaction(pair[1], pair[2])
  }, character(1))
  lines <- c(lines, paste(c(row_labels[i], cells), collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end scriptsize",
  "\\caption{Interaction coefficients}",
  "\\label{tab:psych_spillvoer_interaction}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# 6) write to file (and also print to console)
out_path <- "../results/latex/psych_interaction_table.tex"
dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(lines, out_path)
cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```
